messages:
Rina: FYI we rolled nyx-adapter-v4 into a small shadow and saw reproducible cents/tokenization regressions on int4 probes. Need a compact investigation: LoRA scale sweep + kv-policy matrix + tokenizer pretokenize flags. Keeping it cheap.

Sam: I'll build `nyx_mini_compat` (350 prompts) focusing on invoice lines, sub-dollar amounts (< $5.00), and short code literals. Will include OCR-noise variants and locale permutations (1,200 / 1.200).

Vik: Run matrix proposal: quant=[float32,int8,bnb4-hybrid,bnb4], lora_scale=[0.55,0.65], kv_policy=[preserve-prefix,compact], tokenizer_pretok=[none,normalize-spacing]. Log token probs for tokens: [",", ".", "0"].

Lena: Also capture streaming vs non-streaming outputs; earlier shipping had token-offset drift only on streaming paths. If streaming differs, we should test `--sync-kv true`.

Rina: Starting run on dedicated-nyx-mini: `rwi run --model nyx-adapter-v4 --eval nyx_mini_compat --matrix "quant:float32,int8,bnb4-hybrid,bnb4;lora_scale:0.55,0.65;kv:preserve-prefix,compact;pretok:none,normalize-spacing" --workers 6`

eval-bot: queued at 1745560100, run_id=nyx-1745559999-mini-1, assigned to dedicated-nyx-mini. Streaming progress.

eval-bot: midrun snapshot: float32=98/100; int8=96/100; bnb4-hybrid (best config so far) ~92/100; bnb4 baseline 74/100. Major failure modes: dropped trailing ".00" for small amounts and removed commas in thousand separators. Streaming path shows additional token offset cases.

Sam: Example diffs pasted to artifacts: "Invoice: $1,200.00" -> float32: "$1,200.00" OK; bnb4: "$1200" -> downstream parse mismatch. Small amounts: "$3.50" -> "$3.5" or "$3" depending on quant config.

Vik: Two quick mitigations to try: 1) graft + tiny rebias (600 steps) focused on punctuation and zero token ids; 2) force tokenizer normalization `--pretok normalize-spacing`. Also compare `--kv-policy preserve-prefix` vs compact.

Lena: I kicked an additional run with graft+rebias+pretok normalize and `--sync-kv true`. Command: `rwi retrain --head graft-head --steps 600 --lr 2.5e-5 --freeze base --focus-tokens ", . 0"` then re-eval with bnb4-hybrid.

eval-bot: graft+rebias re-eval complete (run_id=nyx-1745559999-mini-2): bnb4-hybrid + rebias + normalize-spacing + kv-preserve -> pass=91/100. Trailing-cent failures reduced from 8 -> 2. Streaming token-offset cases reduced when `--sync-kv true` enabled.

Sam: Good signal. Recommendation: keep int8 as default for prod, enable bnb4-hybrid+graft+rebias as shadow for nightly smoke only. Add a feature flag to permit customer to opt-in for grafted low-cost endpoints with documented caveats.

Rina: Action items: Sam add `nyx_mini_compat` to nightly smoke, Vik document matrix and graft params, Lena open INFR ticket to verify kernel parity on dedicated-nyx-mini nodes if we see per-host variance. If shadow error >2% in nightly, fallback to int8 automatically. Thanks all :thumbsup:
